item.title: [30736] Dutch Prime Minister's Office — Woo Decision on Jared Kushner Financial Intelligence Briefings (2018)
item.description: On November 4, 2026, the Netherlands Ministry of General Affairs issued a formal decision under the Dutch Open Government Act (Wet open overheid) concerning a request for records establishing whether the Dutch Prime Minister or his office received briefings in 2018 about alleged financial transactions involving Jared Kushner, First Abu Dhabi Bank, and financial institutions in Azerbaijan, Israel, and Cyprus. The ministry reported searching its document management system using multiple names and keywords and consulting relevant personnel. It concluded that no responsive documents were located and denied the request on that basis. The decision identifies the ministry's search methodology and provides instructions for filing an administrative objection. | 2 pages | Source: William Fernandes
